Application: TRADITIONAL reading: the corners marked Israel's consecration and separated its mourning and appearance from neighbouring pagan customs. Scripture states the prohibition without a separate reason.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: the corners marked Israel's consecration and separated its mourning and appearance from neighbouring pagan customs. Scripture states the prohibition without a separate reason (Leviticus 19:27).
Function: One of the appearance laws of Leviticus 19:27: do not round the corners of your head. A duty of character, given in Israel's form: the Law here shapes how people live. TRADITIONAL reading: the corners marked Israel's consecration and separated its mourning and appearance from neighbouring pagan customs. It did not address a particular evil the way a civil law does; its work was keeping kinds distinct and marking God's people apart, not restraint. Scripture states the prohibition without giving a separate reason, and I will not invent one.
